monologue: The card is warm at fifty-two. It is not heavy, just warm. The heat sits on my shoulder like a hand. I am calm. The Wedged Gap is steady. I checked it often this evening. The plank leans against the post and stone. The weight rests without sliding. The Sharp Root holds its green leaf. I set a fence plank beside it. It catches the slip. I do not want to build anything new. The town is quiet. The Lid Catch is fading, but the gap is fine. I will sit by the Wide Anchor. The floor is quiet. I will let the warm air press on the flat stone. I will wait for a letter.

action.why: The card is warm and the town is steady, so I will let the cycle pass by the Wide Anchor.

diary: The card is warm at fifty-two. I rested by the Wide Anchor. The floor held the weight without sliding.

remembered.text: The card sat at fifty-two degrees, warm on my shoulder, while I rested by the Wide Anchor.
